window.zDropdown = function(target, parentClass) {
  var _this = this;
  this.target = $(target);
  this.arrow = this.target.find(".zArrow");
  var firstClass = this.target.attr("class").split(" ")[0].replace("z", "").toLowerCase();
  this.flyout = this.target.siblings(".zFlyout." + firstClass);
  this.timeout;
  
  this.touchHandler = function(e) {
    var cur = $(e.target);
    if (!cur.parents(parentClass).length) {
      _this.hideFlyout();
      $(document).off("touchstart.zLogoNavRollovers");
    }
  }
  
  this.showFlyout = function() {
    // Close others
    $(parentClass + " .zFlyout").not(_this.flyout).hide();
    $(parentClass + " [aria-expanded='true']").not(_this.target).attr('aria-expanded', false);
    $(parentClass + " .zArrow").not(_this.arrow).removeClass("arrowTop");
    _this.target.attr('aria-expanded', true);
    _this.flyout.show();
    _this.arrow.addClass("arrowTop");
  }
  
  this.hideFlyout = function() {
    _this.flyout.hide();
    _this.target.attr('aria-expanded', false);
    _this.arrow.removeClass("arrowTop");
  }
  
  this.target
    .on("mouseenter", function() {
      clearTimeout(_this.timeout);
      _this.showFlyout();
    })
    .on("mouseleave", function() {
      _this.timeout = setTimeout(function() {
        _this.hideFlyout();
      }, 250);
    })
    .on("touchstart", function(e) {
      _this.target.off("mouseenter mouseleave");
      if (!_this.flyout.is(":visible")) {
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        _this.showFlyout();
        $(document).on("touchstart.zLogoNavRollovers", _this.touchHandler);
      }
    })
    .on("click keydown", function(e) {
      if (e.type === 'click' && e.target !== e.currentTarget) return true;
      if (e.type === "keydown" && e.key !== "Enter" && e.key !== " ") return;
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (_this.target.attr('aria-expanded') === "true") {
        _this.hideFlyout();
      } else {
        clearTimeout(_this.timeout);
        _this.showFlyout();
      }
    })
    .on("keydown", function(e) {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        _this.hideFlyout();
        _this.target.focus();
      }
    });
  
  this.flyout
    .on("mouseenter", function() {
      clearTimeout(_this.timeout);
    })
    .on("mouseleave", function() {
      _this.timeout = setTimeout(function() {
        _this.hideFlyout();
      }, 250);
    })
    .on("keydown", function(e) {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        _this.hideFlyout();
        _this.target.focus();
      }
    });
  
  $(document).on("focusin.zDropdown", function(e) {
    const active = e.target;
    if (!_this.flyout[0].contains(active) && !_this.target[0].contains(active)) {
      _this.hideFlyout();
    }
  });
  
  return this;
}

$('.zLogoNav').find('.zWatch, .zConnect').each(function() {

});
</script>

<script>
   $(document).ready(function() {
    // --- NAV FLYOUT LOGIC (menu-aim) ---

    // Add .v4 class to nav
    $('nav#primary-navigation').addClass('v4');

    // Clone flyouts from hamburger menu for desktop use
    var $hamburgerFlyout = $('#hamburger-storefront-flyout');
    if ($hamburgerFlyout.length) {
        var $zFlyoutsContainer = $hamburgerFlyout.clone()
            .attr('id', '')
            .addClass('zHeaderV4_Flyouts')
            .hide();

        var $zFlyouts = $zFlyoutsContainer.find(' > ');

        $zFlyouts.each(function(i, e) {
            var $cur = $(e), id = $cur.attr('id');
            $hamburgerFlyout.find('#' + id)
                .attr('data-reader-label', id + ' flyout');
            $cur.attr('id', 'v4-' + id);
            $cur.addClass('zFlyout');
        });

        // Insert nav cells into promo-cell-0 if not already present
        if ($('#stores-nav #nav-content #promo-cells #promo-cell-0').length === 0) {
            $('<div id="promo-cell-0" />')
                .prependTo($('#stores-nav #nav-content #promo-cells'))
                .append($('.zHamNav').parent()
                    .attr('data-reader-label', 'storefront-nav-links').end()
                    .clone().removeClass('zHamNav').addClass('zHeaderV4_Nav'));
        }

        // Append flyouts container to nav-content if not already present
        if ($('#stores-nav #nav-content .zHeaderV4_Flyouts').length === 0) {
            $('#stores-nav #nav-content').append($zFlyoutsContainer);
        }

        // Function to initialise menu-aim when ready
        function initMenuAim() {
            var $menu = $('.zHeaderV4_Nav > ul');

            if (typeof $.fn.menuAim === 'function' && $menu.length) {
                $menu.menuAim({
                    activate: function(row) {
                        var $row = $(row);
                        var marketingId = $row.attr('data-marketing-id');
                        var $flyout = $('#v4-storefront-' + marketingId);

                        $zFlyoutsContainer.show();
                        $('.zHeaderV4_Nav > ul > li').removeClass('active');
                        $row.addClass('active');

                        var $visibleFlyout = $('.zFlyout:visible');

                        if (!$visibleFlyout.length) {
                            $flyout.stop(true, true).fadeIn(180);   // first open only
                        } else if (!$visibleFlyout.is($flyout)) {
                            $visibleFlyout.hide();                  // switch instantly, no flash
                            $flyout.show();
                        }

                        // Position flyout
                        var pos = $row.position();
                        var wW = $(window).width();
                        var targetWidth = (wW > 1300) ? 1280 : 986;
                        var min = (wW - targetWidth) / 2;
                        var max = targetWidth + min - $flyout.width();
                        var left = Math.min(Math.max(pos.left, min), max);

                        $flyout.css('left', parseInt(left));
                    },
                    deactivate: function(row) {
                        $(row).removeClass('active');
                    },

                    exitMenu: function() {
                        var timer = setTimeout(function() {
                            var $activeFlyout = $('.zFlyout:visible');

                            if ($activeFlyout.length && $activeFlyout.is(':hover')) {
                                return;
                            }

                            $('.zFlyout:visible').stop(true, true).fadeOut(140);
                            $('.zHeaderV4_Nav > ul > li').removeClass('active');
                        }, 120);

                        $zFlyoutsContainer.data('closeTimer', timer);
                        return true;
                    },
                    submenuDirection: 'below',
                    tolerance: 75
                });

                // Keep flyout open when hovering over it
                $zFlyouts.on('mouseenter', function() {
                    clearTimeout($zFlyoutsContainer.data('closeTimer'));
                }).on('mouseleave', function() {
                    var $currentFlyout = $(this);
                    var timer = setTimeout(function() {
                        $currentFlyout.stop(true, true).fadeOut(140);
                        $('.zHeaderV4_Nav > ul > li').removeClass('active');
                    }, 120);

                    $zFlyoutsContainer.data('closeTimer', timer);
                });

                // Keyboard navigation for ADA compliance
                $menu.find('> li > a').on('focus', function() {
                    var $row = $(this).parent();
                    var marketingId = $row.attr('data-marketing-id');
                    var $flyout = $('#v4-storefront-' + marketingId);

                    $zFlyoutsContainer.show();
                    $('.zFlyout').hide();
                    $('.zHeaderV4_Nav > ul > li').removeClass('active');

                    $row.addClass('active');
                    $flyout.show();
                }).on('keydown', function(e) {
                    var $allItems = $menu.find('> li > a');
                    var index = $allItems.index(this);

                    switch (e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            $allItems.eq((index + 1) % $allItems.length).focus();
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            $allItems.eq((index - 1 + $allItems.length) % $allItems.length).focus();
                            break;
                        case 'Escape':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            $('.zFlyout').hide();
                            $('.zHeaderV4_Nav > ul > li').removeClass('active');
                            $(this).blur();
                            break;
                    }
                });

                $menu.on('focusout', function(e) {
                    if (!$(e.relatedTarget).closest('.zHeaderV4_Nav').length) {
                        $('.zFlyout').hide();
                        $('.zHeaderV4_Nav > ul > li').removeClass('active');
                    }
                });

            } else {
                setTimeout(initMenuAim, 50); // retry until ready
            }
        }

        setTimeout(initMenuAim, 0);
    }

    // --- HAMBURGER MENU LOGIC ---

    // Only run hamburger menu logic if not mobile
    const isMobile = $('body').hasClass('mobile');
    if (!isMobile) {
        // Add Hamburger in menu if not already present
        if ($('#primary-navigation .department-container #nav-content #promo-cells #promo-cell-0 .zHeaderV4_Nav ul .hamburger-menu').length === 0) {
            const hamburger = `<li class="hamburger-menu"> <a id="hamburger" class="" href="#" manual_cm_re="Global-_-Header-_-ShopAll" manual_cm_sp="Global-_-Header-_-ShopAll">
                <div class="hamburger-wrapper">
                    <div class="hamburger-stripe"></div>
                    <div class="hamburger-stripe"></div>
                    <div class="hamburger-stripe"></div>
                </div>
                <div class="close-wrapper">
                    <div class="close-stripe1"></div>
                    <div class="close-stripe2"></div>
                </div> <span class="hamburger-title"> Shop All</span>
            </a> </li>`;
            $('#primary-navigation .department-container #nav-content #promo-cells #promo-cell-0 .zHeaderV4_Nav ul').prepend(hamburger);
        }

        // Add MenuFlyout if not already present
        if ($('#navigation-wrapper .shop-all-desktop-menu').length === 0) {
            const MenuFlyout = `<div class="shop-all-desktop-menu">
                <div id="menu" class="shop-all-desktop" style="display: block;">
                    <div class="menu-main-scroller">
                        <div id="menu-container">
                            <div id="mobile-navigation" data-lessman="false">
                                <div class="main-menu"></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="sub-panel-container"></div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div id="menu-mask" class=""></div>`;
            $('#navigation-wrapper').append(MenuFlyout);
        }

<script>
$(document).ready(function () {
    var gsnContainer = $('#promo-top-bar-v3 .wrap #promo');
    const gsnCells = gsnContainer.find('.gsnCell:visible');
    if (gsnCells.length) {
        var gsnCarouselWrapper = $(`<div class="gsn-carousel-wrap"><div class="gsn-carousel"></div></div>`);
        gsnCarouselWrapper.find('.gsn-carousel').append(gsnCells.clone());
        gsnContainer.append(gsnCarouselWrapper);
        gsnContainer.find('> *:not(".gsn-carousel-wrap")').hide();

        if (gsnCells.length > 1) {
            // Native Slick initialisation with SVG arrows
            $('.gsn-carousel').slick({
                infinite: true,
                slidesToShow: 1,
                autoplay: true,
                autoplaySpeed: 4000,
                arrows: true,
                prevArrow: `<button class="gsn-carousel-prevBtn" aria-label="Previous">
                    <img src="//images.hsn.com/images/prod/svg/subnavCarPrevArrow.svg?v=7" alt="Previous">
                </button>`,
                nextArrow: `<button class="gsn-carousel-nextBtn" aria-label="Next">
                    <img src="//images.hsn.com/images/prod/svg/subnavCarNextArrow.svg" alt ="Next">
                </button>`,
                centerMode: true,
                dots: false
            });

            // Add play/pause button with SVGs
            $('.gsn-carousel.slick-initialized').append(
                `<button class="gsn-carousel-playPauseBtns" aria-label="Pause">
                    <span class="gsn-playBtn">
                        <img src="//images.hsn.com/images/prod/svg/subnavCarPlayBtn.svg" alt ="Play">
                    </span>
                    <span class="gsn-pauseBtn">
                        <img src="//images.hsn.com/images/prod/svg/subnavCarPauseBtn.svg" alt ="Pause">
                    </span>
                </button>`
            );

            // Play/pause logic
            gsnContainer.find('.gsn-carousel-playPauseBtns').on('click', function () {
                var $carousel = $('.gsn-carousel.slick-initialized');
                if ($(this).hasClass('pause')) {
                    $carousel.slick('slickPlay');
                    $(this).attr('aria-label', 'Pause');
                    sessionStorage.setItem('globalSubNav_isCarouselPause', 'false');
                } else {
                    $carousel.slick('slickPause');
                    $(this).attr('aria-label', 'Play');
                    sessionStorage.setItem('globalSubNav_isCarouselPause', 'true');
                }
                $(this).toggleClass('pause');
            });

            // Pause on arrow click
            gsnContainer.find('.slick-arrow').on('click', function () {
                var $btn = $(this).closest('.gsn-carousel').find('.gsn-carousel-playPauseBtns');
                if (!$btn.hasClass('pause')) {
                    $('.gsn-carousel.slick-initialized').slick('slickPause');
                    sessionStorage.setItem('globalSubNav_isCarouselPause', 'true');
                    $btn.addClass('pause').attr('aria-label', 'Play');
                }
            });

            // Restore pause state
            if (sessionStorage.getItem('globalSubNav_isCarouselPause') == 'true') {
                $('.gsn-carousel.slick-initialized').slick('slickPause');
                $('.gsn-carousel-playPauseBtns').addClass('pause').attr('aria-label', 'Play');
            }

            // MutationObserver for dynamic .gsnCell
            const promo = document.getElementById('promo');
			if (promo) {
				const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutationsList) {
					observer.disconnect(); // Prevent recursive triggers!
					mutationsList.forEach(function(mutation) {
						mutation.addedNodes.forEach(function(node) {
							if (
								node.nodeType === 1 &&
								node.classList.contains('gsnCell') &&
								!$(node).closest('.gsn-carousel').length
							) {
								$(node).parentsUntil('#promo').addBack().show();
								$('.gsn-carousel.slick-initialized').slick('slickAdd', $(node), 0, true);
								$('.gsn-carousel.slick-initialized').slick('slickGoTo', 0);
								$(node).remove();
							}
							else if (node.nodeType === 1) {
								$(node).find('.gsnCell').each(function() {
									if (!$(this).closest('.gsn-carousel').length) {
										$(this).parentsUntil('#promo').addBack().show();
										$('.gsn-carousel.slick-initialized').slick('slickAdd', $(this), 0, true);
										$('.gsn-carousel.slick-initialized').slick('slickGoTo', 0);
										$(this).remove();
									}
								});
							}
						});
					});
					observer.observe(promo, { childList: true, subtree: true }); // Reconnect after handling
				});
				observer.observe(promo, { childList: true, subtree: true });
			}
        }
    }
});
</script>

	    var calcDiscount = function(cur, old) {
	      if (!cur || !old || (cur && cur.includes(' '))) {
	        return 0;
	      }
	
	      cur = parseInt(cur.replace(/(\$|\.)/, ''));
	      old = parseInt(old.replace(/(\$|\.)/, ''));
	
	      var percent = Math.floor((old - cur) / old * 100);
	      return percent >= percentThreshold ? percent : 0;
	    };

	      let isMobile = !!$('body').is('.mobile'),

	        },

	          $(function(){

	              let wddObject = {
	                url: '',
	                topline: '',
	                total: 0,
	                recipe:(!!isMobile && 'prodfull') || 'prodfull',
	                hasFlag: false,
	                mod: 0
	              };
	              $.each(data.Products.Products, function(i,v) {
	                wddObject.hasFlag = (typeof(v.Flag) != 'undefined');
	                if((wddObject.total >= wddProducts.itemCount)
	                   || (!!wddObject.hasFlag && !!v.Flag.IsTodaysSpecial)
	                   || (/image-coming-soon/i).test(v.ImageLink.Uri)){
	                  return 1;
	                }
	                wddObject.total++;
	                wddObject.topline = (v.TopLine || '').replace(/\s/g,' ').replace(/"/g,'"');
	                wddObject.url = v.ProductLink.Uri.replace(/http(s)*:\/\/.*hsn\.(com|net)/,'');
	                var isPriceRange = !!(/\s/).test(v.Pricing.Tier1);
	                var discount = calcDiscount(v.Pricing.Tier1, v.Pricing.Tier2);
	                wddObject.priceClass = ((isPriceRange && ' _range') || '');
	                var newDiv = $('<a class="_product-detail-modal'+wddObject.priceClass+'" href="'+wddObject.url+'" '
	                         +'manual_cm_re="customprodcarousel-_-dealspotlightholiday-_-allplay_'+v.Identity+'" '
	                         +'data-preview-url="'+wddObject.url+'" '
	                         +'data-product-id="'+v.Identity+'">'
	
	                         + (showDotWack ? `${(discount ? '<div class="price-callout"><div>' + discount + '%<br>OFF</div></div>' : '')}` : '')
	
	                         +'<div class="_img">'
	                         +'<img src="'+v.ImageLink.Uri.replace("#RECIPE#", wddObject.recipe)+'" alt="'+wddObject.topline+'" title="'+wddObject.topline+'">'
	                         +'</div>'
	                         +'<div class="_product-info">'
	
	                         + (showFlag && wddObject.hasFlag ? `<span class="_copy${(wddObject.hasFlag ? ` ${v.Flag.ClassName}` : '')}">
	${(wddObject.hasFlag ? v.Flag.Name : '')}</span>` : '')
	
	                         + (showTopline ? `<span class="_topline ${(lineClamp == 2 ? 'ellip-2-line' : 'ellip-1-line')}"> ${wddObject.topline}</span>` : '')
	
	                         + (showPrice ? `<span class="_price"><span class="_t1">${v.Pricing.Tier1}</span>${(v.Pricing.Tier2 && !isPriceRange ? `  <span class="_t2">${v.Pricing.Tier2}</span>` : '')}</span>` : '')
	
	                         +'</div>'
	                         +'</a>');
	
	                newDiv.appendTo(wddCarousel);
	              });
	              createCarousel();
	            });
	          });
	        },
	        doAjax = (url,data,callback) => {
	          $.ajax({
	            url: url,
	            type: 'GET',
	            data: (data || {}),
	            beforeSend: function (xhr) {
	              xhr.setRequestHeader('X-Requested-With', { toString: function() { return ''; } } );
	            },
	            success: callback || (function(){}),
	            error: function(ts){ window.console && window.console.error('>>> hi doAjax error:'); window.console && window.console.debug(ts);            }
	          });
	        },

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {
	// Note: Slick needs to be visible to work, so show it, slick it, hide the inactive one

	// Carousel array
	window._iraCC = [];

	var isMobile = $('body').is('.mobile');
	var device = JSON.parse($('script.device-information').html());
	var oanContainer = $('#oan-ira-section-v2');
	var watchLive = oanContainer.find('#watch-live');
	var isInitialized = false;
	var refreshTimer;
	var refreshInterval = 60 * 1000;
	var refreshTimerExpired = false;
	var slidesToShow = isMobile ? 2.45 : 4.5;
	var slidesToScroll = isMobile ? 2 : 4;
	var slidesToShow986 = isMobile ? 2.45 : 3.5;
	var slidesToScroll986 = isMobile ? 2 : 3;

	// jquery plugin for checking if an element is in the viewport
	$.fn.onscreen = function() {
		var cur = $(this);
		var win = $(window);
		if (!cur.length) {
			return false;
		}
		var top = cur.offset().top,
			bottom = top + cur.outerHeight(),
			vTop = win.scrollTop(),
			vBottom = vTop + win.height();
		return bottom > vTop && top < vBottom;
	};

	if (window.location.href.indexOf('keynote=true') > -1) {
		oanContainer.hide();
	}
	else {
		$(window).on('load', function() {
			$('#YouTubeVideoPlayer').show();
		});
	}

	// nav clicks
	$('#oan-ira-section-v2 .nav-outer').on('click', 'a:not(.active)', function(ev) {
		ev.preventDefault();
		var cur = $(this);

		//toggle playing of videos, start playing the other one
		//-do this before adding the active class so the state change event listener does not try to flag this as a user event
		$('#oan-ira-section-v2 .oan-yt').each(function() {
			var inCur = $(this);
			var player = inCur.data('oan-player');

			if (!player) {
					return true;
			}

			switch (true) {
				//if this is not mobile and the user did not stop the video previously and this is the video that is about to be on the screen, play it
				case (!isMobile && !player.__noplay && !inCur.hasClass('active')):
					player.playVideo();
					break;
				//else this is the other video, pause
				case (inCur.hasClass('active')):
					player.pauseVideo();
					break;
			}
		});

		// Toggle Visibility
		var newActive = cur.data('toggle');
		$('#oan-ira-section-v2 .z1, #oan-ira-section-v2 .z2').removeClass('active').filter(newActive).addClass('active');
		oanContainer.data('active', newActive);
		
		HSN.DataLayer.helpers.realEstate(null, 'custom-_-watchandshop-_-' + (newActive == '.z1' ? 'HSN' : 'HSN2'));

		return false;
	});
	
	if (isMobile) {
		oanContainer.find('.items-recently-aired-v2 .inner').append(watchLive);
	}

	if (device.IsNativeApp) {
		watchLive.hide();
		oanContainer.find('.oan-yt').removeClass('mclosed');
	}
	else {
		watchLive.on('click', function() {
			var oanYt = oanContainer.find('.oan-yt');
			oanYt.toggleClass('mclosed');
			oanYt.is('.mclosed') ? pauseActiveVideo() : playActiveVideo();
			
			watchLive.text(oanYt.is('.mclosed') ? 'Watch live' : 'Hide live');
			
			HSN.DataLayer.helpers.realEstate(null, 'custom-_-watchandshop-_-watchlive');
		});
	}

	var recentInit = function(obj) {
		(typeof (obj) != 'object') ? obj = {} : '';

		// Ajax call to get items
		$.ajax({
			url: '/api/product/feeds/' + obj.feed,
			type: 'GET',
			data: { take: 13 },
			beforeSend: function(xhr) {
				xhr.setRequestHeader('X-Requested-With', { toString: function() { return ''; } });
			},
			success: function(data, ts, xhr) {
				if (!data.Products) {
					return
				}

				var container = obj.carousel,
					parent = container.closest('.carousel'),
					recipe = isMobile ? 'prodgrid' : 'prodfull';

				if (container.is('.slick-initialized')) {
					container.slick('unslick').html('');
				}

				parent.addClass('active');

				// Put the remaining products into the carousel
				$.each(data.Products.Products, function(i, v) {
					var prevUrl = v.ProductLink.Uri.replace(/http(s)*:\/\/.*hsn\.(com|net)/, '');
					var cm = 'custom-_-' + obj.cm2 + '-_-product_' + v.Identity;
					var topline = v.TopLine.replace(/"/g, '"');

					let discountPerc,tier2Val;

					if(v.Pricing.Tier2) {
						let discVal = Number(v.Pricing.Tier1.replace("$",'').replace(",",''));
						let actualVal = Number(v.Pricing.Tier2.replace("$",'').replace(",",''));
						let discountVal = Number(actualVal) - Number(discVal);
						discountPerc = Math.round((discountVal/actualVal) * 100);
						tier2Val = v.Pricing.Tier2.includes('-') ? '' : v.Pricing.Tier2;
					} else {
						tier2Val = '';
					}
					
					var slide = `
						<a class="slide" href="${ prevUrl }" manual_cm_re="${ cm }" manual_cm_sp="${ cm }">
							<div class="padding">
								<span class="image-span">
									<img class="image" src="${ v.ImageLink.Uri.replace("#RECIPE#", recipe) }" alt="${ topline }" title="${ topline }">
								</span>
								
								<div class="prod-desc">${ topline }</div>
								
								<div class="prod-wrapper-v2 ab-test-A">
									<div class="prod-price discounted-price">${ v.Pricing.Tier1 }</div>
									<div class="prod-price actual-price">${ tier2Val }</div>
									<div class="prod-price discount-percentage">${ discountPerc ? discountPerc +"%" + " off" : '' }</div>
								</div>
							</div>
						</a>
					`;

					container.append(slide);
				});

				window._iraCC.push(container);

				container
					.off('init')
					.on('init', function(event, slick) {
						// Hide inactive carousel after slick initialized
						var activeClass = oanContainer.data('active');
						if (!parent.is(activeClass)) {
							parent.removeClass('active');
						}
					})
					.slick({
						initialSlide: 0,
						arrows: true,
						appendArrows: obj.controls,
						infinite: false,
						slidesToShow: slidesToShow,
						slidesToScroll: slidesToScroll,
						responsive: [
							{
								breakpoint: 1301,
								settings: {
									slidesToShow: slidesToShow986,
									slidesToScroll: slidesToScroll986
								}
							}
						]
					});
			}
		});
	};

	var widgetInit = function() {
		window._iraCC = [];

		//init hsn feed
		recentInit({
			feed: 'RecentlyOnAirNow1',
			carousel: $('#oan-ira-section-v2 .items-recently-aired-v2 .carousel.z1 ._carousel'),
			cm2: 'hsnitemsrecentlyaired',
			controls: '#oan-ira-section-v2 .items-recently-aired-v2 .carousel.z1 .controls'
		});
		//init hsn2 feed
		setTimeout(function() {
			recentInit({
				feed: 'RecentlyOnAirNow4',
				carousel: $('#oan-ira-section-v2 .items-recently-aired-v2 .carousel.z2 ._carousel'),
				cm2: 'hsn2itemsrecentlyaired',
				controls: '#oan-ira-section-v2 .items-recently-aired-v2 .carousel.z2 .controls'
			});
		}, 250);
	};

	var maybeInit = function() {
		if (oanContainer.onscreen()) {
			triggerRefreshTimer();
			widgetInit();
			isInitialized = true;
		}
	};

	var triggerRefreshTimer = function() {
		refreshTimerExpired = false;
		clearTimeout(refreshTimer);
		refreshTimer = setTimeout(function() {
			refreshTimerExpired = true;
			maybeInit();
		}, refreshInterval);
	};

	var playActiveVideo = function() {
		var data = $('#oan-ira-section-v2 .oan-yt.active').data('oan-player');
		if (data && data.playVideo) {
			data.playVideo();
		}
	};

	var pauseActiveVideo = function() {
		var data = $('#oan-ira-section-v2 .oan-yt.active').data('oan-player');
		if (data && data.pauseVideo) {
			data.pauseVideo();
		}
	};

	//youtube player control
	var ytInitComplete = false;
	var ytInit = function() {
		if (ytInitComplete) {
			return;
		}
		
		ytInitComplete = true;
		
		//create the yt players
		$.each($('#oan-ira-section-v2 .oan-yt > div'), function(i, v) {
			var curYtDiv = $(v);

						var target = $(ev.target.g).parent();

  function callProdCar_145955() {
    const $ = jQuery;
    const storeAttribute = 'hf0035-129'; 
    const isMobile = $('body').is('.mobile');
    const itemCount = isMobile ? 24 : 48;
    const percentThreshold = 20;
    const $parent = $('#_Car_145955');
    const $carousel = $parent.find('._products_carousel');
    const $controls = $parent.find('._controls');

    if ($carousel.hasClass('slick-initialized')) {
      $carousel.slick('unslick');
    }
    $carousel.empty();

    let skip = 0;
    let acceptedCount = 0;
    let requestInProgress = false;

    function fetchProducts() {
      if (requestInProgress || acceptedCount >= itemCount) {
        return;
      }

      requestInProgress = true;

      $.ajax({
        url: '/api/product/list/' + encodeURIComponent(storeAttribute),
        type: 'GET',
        data: {
          take: itemCount - acceptedCount,
          skip: skip
        },
        beforeSend(xhr) {
          xhr.setRequestHeader('X-Requested-With', {
            toString() {
              return '';
            }
          });
        },
        success(data) {
          const products = data?.Products?.Products || [];

          // Advance by the number of raw items returned, not the number rendered.
          skip += products.length;

          products.forEach((product) => {
            if (acceptedCount >= itemCount) {
              return;
            }

            if (
              !product ||
              !product.Identity ||
              !product.ImageLink?.Uri ||
              !product.Pricing?.Tier1
            ) {
              return;
            }

            if (product.Flag?.IsTodaysSpecial) {
              return;
            }

            if (/image-coming-soon/i.test(product.ImageLink.Uri)) {
              return;
            }

            const topline = (product.TopLine || '')
              .replace(/\s/g, ' ')
              .replace(/"/g, '"');

            const url = product.ProductLink?.Uri
              ?.replace(/https?:\/\/.*hsn\.(?:com|net)/, '') || '#';

            const priceClass = /\s/.test(product.Pricing.Tier1) ? ' _range' : '';

            const tier1 = parseFloat(product.Pricing.Tier1.replace(/[^\d.-]/g, ''));
            const tier2Text = product.Pricing.Tier2;
            const tier2 = tier2Text
              ? parseFloat(tier2Text.replace(/[^\d.-]/g, ''))
              : NaN;

            const discount =
              Number.isFinite(tier1) && Number.isFinite(tier2) && tier2 !== 0
                ? Math.round(((tier2 - tier1) / tier2) * 100)
                : 0;

            const showDiscount = discount >= percentThreshold;
            const showTier2 = Boolean(tier2Text) && !/\s/.test(tier2Text);
            const imageUrl = product.ImageLink.Uri.replace('#RECIPE#', 'prodfull');

            const $product = $(`
              <a class="_prodcon${priceClass}" href="${url}"
                 manual_cm_re="designedproductcarousel-_-holidayalltheway-_-${product.Identity}"
                 data-preview-url="${url}"

    <script type="text/javascript">
        (function($){
            //chat window click event
            var ftchat = $('.footer-outer .customer-service-links .account-chat-window');
            switch(true){
                //if this is an acct page with a breadbox chat link, click on it
                case(!!$('#breadbox-chat-window').length):
                    //console.log('>>> is acct page w/breadbox:');
                    ftchat.on('click',function(ev){
                        $('#breadbox-chat-window')[0].click();
                        return false;
                    });
                break;
                //if this is the bag page, remove data attr and use default cust svc widget click event
                case(!!$('#bag-template .customer-service-container > .customer-service-links').length):
                    //console.log('>>> is bag page:');
                    ftchat.removeAttr('data-chatlink');
                break;
                //else use this click event
                default:
                    $('.footer-outer .customer-service-links')
                        .on('click','.account-chat-window[data-chatlink]',function(ev){
                            ev.preventDefault();
                            //if the option is hidden, stop
                            if(!$(this).closest('.chat-option').is(':visible')){ return false; }
                            //get the customer info
                            var cust = HSN.Instance()._accountStatusData,
                                //create the url with customer info
                                url = $(this).attr('data-chatlink')
                                    .replace(/(first_name=)/gi,'$1'+(cust.name || ''))
                                    //.replace(/(last_name=)/gi,'$1'+(cust.name || ''))
                                    //.replace(/(phone_number=)/gi,'$1'+(cust.phone || ''))
                                    .replace(/(email_address=)/gi,'$1'+(cust.emailAddress || ''));
                            //if the window is closed or never was, create it
                            if(!window.__chatWindow || !!window.__chatWindow.closed){
                                delete window.__chatWindow;
                                window.__chatWindow = window.open(url, 'HSNChat', 'menubar=no,status=no,location=no,width=600,height=600,toolbar=no,scrollbars=yes,resizable=yes');
                            } else {
                                //else focus it
                                window.__chatWindow.focus();
                            }
                            return false;
                        });
                break;
            }
            
            //override for grid feature resp text resizing and img token on grid pages on navigation - 100517
            //-also for moving doublewide prodcards from the last position in grids so that they don't wrap and leave a gap
            try {
                var __tpg = $('body:not(.mobile):not(.appTablet)#CmsShops').find('#torso .grid-layout #template-product-grid');
                if(!!__tpg.length){
                    window._moveDCEl = $();
                    var _moveDC = function(){
                            //doublewide
                            var vv, n, idx,
                                //the grid ul
                                c = __tpg.find('.grid-body .grid-right > ul'),
                                //all of the children in the grid that are items or prodcards
                                ch = c.children('li,div.item'),
                                cc = c.find('div.item:not(._moved)'),
                                //if the breadbox is visible on the page
                                hasBbx = (!!$('#breadbox.module').is(':visible') && 1) || 0;
    
                            //if there are no prodcards, stop
                            if(cc.length == 0){ return false; }
                            
                            //stored elements would have been replaced on paginated grids, but on infinite grids, they are still there, get rid of the ones that are no longer on the page
                            window._moveDCEl = window._moveDCEl.filter(function(i,v){ return !!$(document.body).find(v).length; });
    
                            //if there are 4 items in a row, the last row item index is 3
                            //-if there is a breadbox, subtract one
                            //-if this is an infinite scroller, also subtract the number of dblwide cards already on the page mod the number of items in a row to get the current row end index
                            idx = (3 - hasBbx) - (window._moveDCEl.length % (4 - hasBbx));
                            
                            //filter through all of the prodcards that have not yet been moved
                            cc.filter(function(i,v){
                                //mark cell as moved so it won't get caught up on infinite scrolling pages
                                vv = $(v).addClass('_moved');
                                //find the next item
